text:
maria: heads-up — after last night's runtime rollout (v2.7.1) we started getting support escalations: p95 ~300ms -> 800ms, p99 jumped to ~1.6s for /v1/generate. tickets coming in from 03:07 UTC. anyone oncall?

tao: oncall here. seeing the spike in prometheus dashboards: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/serving/latency-overview?var-service=api - p99 jumps line up exactly at 03:04 when canary traffic was shifted to 10%.

maria: canary targets were 10% in us-west only. rollout plan said kernel-selector default change + batching tweaks. suspect kernel-selector change.

tao: checking per-pod traces now. short traces show queuing latency before token generation step. flamegraph link: https://perf.internal/flame/3031415926

tao: logs show repeated messages: `WARN kv_cache: miss ratio increased 12%` and `hotpath_queue: enqueue_time 20-200ms` — looks like KV cache eviction pattern changed after kernel swap.

anita: @tao can you paste a sample stack/log snippet? I'll open the support ticket reply.

tao: sample: ```
[2026-03-15T03:04:12Z] request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate pod=runtime-7bbfd kernel=sel_v2 exec_ms=28 queue_ms=154 total_ms=182
[2026-03-15T03:04:12Z] WARN kv_cache: evicting key modelA:pref_... size=48MB
[2026-03-15T03:04:13Z] hotpath_queue: avg_enqueue_ms=120 p99_enqueue_ms=420
```

leo: interesting — the `kernel=sel_v2` change was accompanied by a default `max_batch_size` reduction in the config. that can increase per-request latency if initial batching is smaller and queueing happens.

maria: do we have any canary logs from pods that didn't pick sel_v2? compare sel_v1 vs sel_v2.

tao: yes, I diffed aggregated histograms: sel_v1 p99=260ms, sel_v2 p99=1.5s, p95 also higher. I'm starting a bisect across the release diff (kernel selector flag vs batching default vs kv-cache tuning).

support-bot: New ticket created: S-8241 assigned to @anita — Customer: paycorp, severity=high, examples attached.

anita: I'll ack ticket and send interim reply: "We're investigating a latency regression after a runtime change; rolling mitigations now."

maria: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback to v2.7.0 for all canaries / stop rollout, 2) pin kernel selector to sel_v1, 3) increase cache size / adjust eviction policy, 4) bump burst capacity to drain queue. which is fastest?

tao: fastest is to stop the canary (shift traffic back to 0%) and optionally patch the config to force kernel=sel_v1 on canary pods. I can do both.

leo: if we rollback, we should snapshot logs + traces for bisecting. use `kubectl -n runtime set image deployment/runtime runtime=image:v2.7.0 --record` and keep one canary set with sel_v2 for repro.

tao: executing stop canary now: `./opsctl rollout set-canary --service=runtime --percent=0 --region=us-west`

maria: noted. also add a quick prod alert to slack if p99 > 1s for more than 2m.

tao: canary stopped at 03:18 UTC. rolling back canary pods to v2.7.0 in us-west.

(ops system): rollout job started for runtime/us-west v2.7.0 -> good. job id=roll-3031416

anita: I've notified PayCorp support contact and gave ETA ~30m. asked for examples and the worst request IDs.

tao: rollback completed at 03:37 UTC. p99 dropped to ~280ms within single minute on main signals. Prom link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/serving/latency-overview?from=3031415600&to=3031419800

maria: great — mitigation success. next: full bisect plan to pinpoint root cause and prevent regression. assign owners and steps.

tao: plan: 1) reproduce in staging with same model and load using v2.7.1, toggling kernel-selector alone (sel_v1 vs sel_v2). 2) if reproduces, test batching defaults change in isolation. 3) check kv-cache sizing/GC effects in v2.7.1 code paths. I'll run steps 1-2.

leo: I'll prepare a minimal repro harness (locally runnable) that hits hotpath and emits KV cache stats; will run bisect script across commit ranges.

anita: I'll update ticket S-8241 with rollback note, timeline, and expected follow-up (bisect + permanent fix).

maria: follow-ups: tao to post bisect findings, leo to open PR with hardening (fallback to sel_v1 if p99 cutoff exceeded), anita to close/update support ticket.

tao: acknowledged. starting staging repro now. attaching quick repro command for the team: ```
# run load test (10 rps) against staging runtime
wrk -t4 -c50 -d60s -s scripts/post_generate.lua --latency http://staging-runtime.internal/v1/generate
```

maria: thanks — post updates here. leaving incident open until bisect complete. :white_check_mark:

anita: added follow-up tasks to support ticket and pinged customer.

leo: initial staging run shows sel_v2 p99 ~1.3s under the same load. capturing heap/profile.

tao: good repro — next isolate: toggle only batching config. will report back in ~1h.

maria: nice work everyone, especially for quick rollback. closing urgent cycle; we'll reconvene for postmortem after bisect.

support-bot: Ticket S-8241 updated: status=investigating, last_update=3031419326
